```python
import os

def block_website(ip_address, domain):
    # Define the iptables command to block the website
    command = f"sudo iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -m string --string '{domain}' --algo bm -j DROP"
    
    try:
        # Execute the command
        os.system(command)
        print(f"Access to {domain} has been blocked from {ip_address}.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

# Example usage
block_website("192.168.1.100", "example.com")

# To remove the rule and allow access again
def unblock_website(ip_address, domain):
    # Define the iptables command to remove the block
    command = f"sudo iptables -D OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -m string --string '{domain}' --algo bm -j DROP"
    
    try:
        # Execute the command
        os.system(command)
        print(f"Access to {domain} has been unblocked from {ip_address}.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

# Example usage
unblock_website("192.168.1.100", "example.com")
```
